study: Kather full-k TRAIN color and physical phase perturbation control
kd_gate: Teacher argmax is correct AND its correct-label probability exceeds detached student correct-label probability
inference: Original ScalingOptics N49/k49 and router temperature0.05; clean RGB; model.eval disables phase perturbation; no teacher or new inference parameters
training: Both recipes use stateless TRAIN-only RGB**channel_gain augmentation and joint differential-LR optimization from start. phase_color additionally uses phase_noise_std0.02 already implemented in ScalingOptics; eval mode disables noise. Reset AdamW and live/EMA from source selected EMA.
selection: VAL accuracy then NLL, include source best; choose recipe before TEST; rollout to27/37 only if >=4 more correct VAL examples
supersedes: Staged and confidence-gated distillation both stopped at three epochs without VAL benefit; existing selected source and TEST preserved, no rollout. This separate profile uses the remaining finite method budget.
